voices.name: Kristen - Friendly and Casual BFF
voices.description: Warm, natural, and approachable female voice with a relaxed, down-to-earth, and easy-going style. Genuine, clear, and engaging with smooth, soft-tone delivery and relatable, mid-tempo pacing for a real-person, one-on-one feel. Inviting, personal, and trustworthy—perfect for storytelling, lifestyle content, chatbots, and tutorials.

voices.name: Lyan - Female Genuine Casual Ads
voices.description: warm, conversational tone and natural vocal fry. Sounds like a friend. Casual, upbeat, and approachable. Perfect for digital ads, social media spots, DTC brand reads, podcast ad reads, and explainer videos that want energy without sounding overly polished or corporate.

voices.name: Hope - Bubbly, Gossipy and Girly
voices.description: A voice that sounds like a genuine conversation — natural mmms, ahhs, chuckles, and pauses make her perfectly imperfect, like chatting with a close friend or thoughtful AI therapist. Perfect for any AI assistant, best friend, therapist, audiobook or podcast!

voices.name: Jessa - Easygoing and Effortless
voices.description: A natural, effortless, and relatable female voice with a casual, off-the-cuff style that feels genuinely real.

voices.name: Lyan - Friendly Female Authentic UGC
voices.description:
Upbeat American accent with a natural girl-next-door charm. Approachable, sweet, and never overly polished. Her tone sits comfortably between casual and confident—an authentic fit for UGC ads, product reviews, and storytime reels where authenticity matters. 

Best use cases: UGC ad scripts, Reels voiceovers, explainer videos, product demos, relatable storytelling content, and social captions read aloud.
